summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on diagnostics PR #416 exact head 183bea8da6462facb2a2429ebbc85b9b80a01869. The generation-8 one-line final post-disable re-enable fence is correct and exact-head canonical CI is green, but two source-only evidence-integrity gaps remain before this lane is integration-ready. First, canonical world integrity cannot currently be proven while diagnostics are enabled; PR #422 exposes the missing enabled-window check, but its raw source-text regression is false-passable by comments and its prescribed direct Validation.captureFull call would currently reject the diagnostics-owned root as an unexpected direct representation, so the successor needs a real diagnostics-aware canonical-validation seam plus behaviorally robust coverage rather than absorbing #422 verbatim. Second, standalone diagnostics preflight/capture projects representation.Name and UNRENDERED_RepresentationClass from mutable owned Instance metadata without proving those fields against authoritative recipe/representation truth; an exact-owned Instance can therefore publish coherent-looking false diagnostic keys/classes. Keep viewport evidence blocked externally; these are source/test correctness issues only.
